import json,os,pathlib,signal,socket,subprocess,tempfile,time,sys
binary=sys.argv[1]
rows=[]
for n in range(int(sys.argv[2])):
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='s4052-') as d:
  p=pathlib.Path(d); (p/'project').mkdir()
  env=dict(os.environ,RUPD_SOCKET=str(p/'x.sock'),ROUNDUP_DATA_DIR=str(p/'data'),TOKIO_WORKER_THREADS='4')
  load=os.getloadavg(); begun=time.perf_counter_ns()
  proc=subprocess.Popen([binary,str(p/'project')],env=env,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,start_new_session=True)
  failure=None
  try:
   while True:
    if time.perf_counter_ns()-begun>10e9: raise RuntimeError('startup deadline')
    try:
     sock=socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX);sock.connect(str(p/'x.sock'));break
    except (FileNotFoundError,ConnectionRefusedError): sock.close(); time.sleep(.0001)
   sock.settimeout(10);sock.sendall(b'{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"daemon.ping","params":{}}\n')
   reply=b''
   while not reply.endswith(b'\n'): reply+=sock.recv(4096)
   elapsed=(time.perf_counter_ns()-begun)/1e6
   assert json.loads(reply)['result']['pong'] is True,reply
   sock.close()
  except Exception as e: failure=repr(e);elapsed=None
  finally:
   os.killpg(proc.pid,signal.SIGTERM); _,log=proc.communicate(timeout=10)
  rows.append(dict(n=n,load=load,wall_ms=elapsed,process_exit=proc.returncode,exit=0 if failure is None else 1,error=failure,log=log.decode()))
print(json.dumps(rows))
assert all(x['exit']==0 for x in rows)

import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,platform,statistics,subprocess,sys,time
out=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]); before=sys.argv[2]; after=sys.argv[3]
def call(binary,n):
 p=subprocess.run(['python3','/tmp/4052-probe.py',binary,str(n)],capture_output=True,text=True)
 return dict(command=['python3','/tmp/4052-probe.py',binary,str(n)],exit=p.returncode,samples=json.loads(p.stdout),stderr=p.stderr)
report=dict(reference_sha='7fbf5d6ff7bbc2702f152112caad01caca45daa0',head_sha='0666f2d3a0a5b9012de4c9b8aa236390f6b544de',checkout_sha=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),utc=time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ',time.gmtime()),uname=platform.uname()._asdict(),cpu=subprocess.check_output(['lscpu'],text=True),toolchain=subprocess.check_output(['rustc','-Vv'],text=True),ncpus=os.cpu_count(),affinity=sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0)),binaries={x:hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(x).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for x in [before,after]},warmups=[call(before,5),call(after,5)],pairs=[])
for pair in range(9):

 for name,binary in ([('reference',before),('head',after)] if pair%2==0 else [('head',after),('reference',before)]):
  row.append(dict(side=name,**call(binary,10)))

for side in ['reference','head']:
